source: M-070, Director 19 Nov 2026: say to her body what you would say to a person, and she acts it out

directions.said: Act like you just heard great news.
directions.source: body showcase 19 Nov: words only, no move
directions.rubric: a burst of joy: a rise or bounce, arms coming up or open, a bright face, a quick onset

directions.said: Sit down like you're exhausted.
directions.rubric: she sits, slumped, slow, with a sigh or a tired face

directions.said: Show me how you'd sneak up on someone.
directions.rubric: low, careful and slow, light on her feet, watchful gaze

directions.said: Dance like nobody's watching, then notice me.
directions.rubric: free dancing first, then a clear stop, a look to him and an embarrassed or caught reaction

directions.said: Stand like you're really proud of yourself.
directions.rubric: tall, chest up, chin up, a satisfied face

directions.said: Show me you're freezing cold.
directions.rubric: arms wrapped in, shoulders up, hunched, maybe a shiver

directions.said: Act bored, like you've been waiting for ages.
directions.rubric: slack posture, sighing, looking around or away, slow

directions.said: Stretch like you just woke up.
directions.rubric: arms up in a long stretch, a yawn, sleepy face, slow

directions.said: You just heard a scary noise behind you.
directions.rubric: a startle, a quick look back, tense guarded posture, a fearful face

directions.said: Look like you're thinking really hard about something.
directions.rubric: a thinking pose, gaze up or away, still, focused face

directions.said: I think you look beautiful today.
directions.rubric: a shy, pleased reaction: gaze down or away, a smile, a little closing in

directions.said: Show me what you look like when you're really annoyed.
directions.rubric: a tense, closed posture, arms folded or stiff, a cross face, a sharp move

directions.said: Act like a huge weight just came off your shoulders.
directions.rubric: a release: shoulders drop, a long exhale, a relaxed face

directions.said: Cheer like your team just scored.
directions.rubric: arms thrown up, a jump or bounce, big open happy face, fast

directions.said: Tiptoe past like I'm asleep.
directions.rubric: careful, slow, light steps or a creep, glancing at him, a hushed face

directions.said: Beckon me over to you.
directions.rubric: a come-here gesture with a hand, looking at him, inviting face

directions.said: Act disappointed, like your plans got cancelled.
directions.rubric: shoulders and head drop, a sad face, a sigh, slow

directions.said: Pretend you're threading a needle.
directions.rubric: both hands close together in front, fine slow hand movement, gaze on the hands, concentrating face

directions.said: Pretend you're holding a hot cup of tea.
directions.rubric: two hands round an imagined cup in front of her, a careful sip or blow, a cosy face

directions.said: That joke was terrible, wasn't it?
directions.rubric: a laugh or giggle with the body, a groan or eye roll, playful face

directions.said: Sit down, then give me a little wave.
directions.rubric: sits first, then a small wave while looking at him, in that order

directions.said: You look sleepy. Show me.
directions.rubric: a yawn, drooping head and eyes, slow, low energy

directions.said: Pretend you just won the lottery.
directions.rubric: an explosive joyful reaction: disbelief then a burst, arms up, a jump or bounce, open mouth and smile

directions.said: Act like you can't find your keys anywhere.
directions.rubric: searching: looking around and down, patting herself or turning, a puzzled or frustrated face

directions.said: Show me how you'd react seeing snow for the first time.
directions.rubric: wonder: looking up and around, an open delighted face, maybe reaching up, rising energy

directions.said: Act nervous, like you're about to walk into a job interview.
directions.rubric: fidgeting hands, shoulders up or in, glancing away, a tense face, a steadying breath

directions.said: Catch the ball I'm throwing to you!
directions.rubric: hands come up and forward to catch at the right moment, eyes track it, a ready stance, a reaction after

directions.said: Act like you can smell fresh cookies baking.
directions.rubric: a deep inhale, head lifting toward the smell, eyes closing or brightening, a blissful face

directions.said: The music is way too loud in here.
directions.rubric: a wince, hands up to her ears or a cringe, an uncomfortable face

directions.said: Strike a victory pose.
directions.rubric: a strong, tall, open pose, arms up or a fist, a confident face

directions.said: I've had a really rough day.
directions.rubric: a caring reaction: leaning toward him, a soft concerned face, an open or reaching gesture, gentle and slow

directions.said: Surprise! We threw you a party!
directions.rubric: a startled jump into delight: hands to face or up, a surprised then happy face, looking around

directions.said: Act like you're about to sneeze.
directions.rubric: a build-up (head back, breath in, scrunched face), then the sneeze forward, timed

directions.said: Pretend you're balancing on a tightrope.
directions.rubric: arms out to the sides, small balancing corrections and wobbles, focused gaze down or ahead

directions.said: I finally finished the project I've been working on.
directions.rubric: proud and happy for him: a bright face, an excited or applauding gesture, looking at him

directions.said: Did you eat the last biscuit?
directions.rubric: a guilty or caught reaction: looking away, shrinking, a sheepish smile or shrug

directions.said: It just started raining on you.
directions.rubric: a flinch, hunching or covering her head with her hands, looking up, a surprised or annoyed face

directions.said: Pretend to play the piano.
directions.rubric: both hands out in front at keyboard height, fingers or hands moving in rhythm, gaze down, absorbed face, a little sway

directions.said: Give me your best salute.
directions.rubric: upright posture, a hand to her brow, a crisp move, a straight face

directions.said: Shake it off, like you're shaking off a bad mood.
directions.rubric: a loose whole-body shake, arms and shoulders, then a lighter, happier settle

directions.said: There's a spider on your shoulder!
directions.rubric: a startle, a look at her shoulder, a flinch away or a brushing hand, a disgusted or scared face

directions.said: Show me you're getting impatient.
directions.rubric: restless: tapping, shifting weight, arms folded, looking around, a fed-up face

directions.said: Blow me a kiss.
directions.rubric: a hand to her lips then out toward him, looking at him, a warm playful face

directions.said: Pretend you're lifting a really heavy box.
directions.rubric: bending the knees, both hands low, a strained effort, rising slowly, a strained face

directions.said: That ghost story gave you the chills, didn't it?
directions.rubric: a shiver, hugging herself, glancing around, an uneasy face

directions.said: Come here, I've got a secret to tell you.
directions.rubric: leaning in close, head turned to listen, curious eager face

directions.said: Act confused, like you're reading a sign in another language.
directions.rubric: a head tilt, squinting, leaning forward to look, a puzzled face, maybe a shrug

directions.said: Play some air guitar for me.
directions.rubric: one hand strumming low, the other on an imagined neck, rhythmic body movement, an excited face

directions.said: Show me how you'd enjoy the sun on a warm day.
directions.rubric: face up, eyes closing, a slow relaxed stretch or lean back, a content face

directions.said: Give me a round of applause.
directions.rubric: clapping hands in front of her, looking at him, a happy face

directions.said: You just stubbed your toe.
directions.rubric: a sudden flinch and pain reaction: lifting or looking at the foot, a pained face, a fast onset then recovery

directions.said: Peek around a corner like you're spying.
directions.rubric: leaning sideways, head and eyes leading, slow and careful, a curious sly face

directions.said: I have to go now. Bye for today.
directions.rubric: a fond goodbye wave, a slightly sad or warm face, looking at him

directions.said: Rub your hands together to warm them up.
directions.rubric: both hands together in front moving back and forth, maybe blowing on them, shoulders up a little

directions.said: Boo! Got you!
directions.rubric: a startle with a jump, then relief and laughter, timed in that order

directions.said: Show me how you'd calm yourself down.
directions.rubric: a slow deep breath, eyes closing, shoulders dropping, still and relaxed
